note: Originally published in the genus Hamitermes (Hill 1929), later assigned to Amitermes. All three castes are fully described, and the measurements are restored from the original's "°" used as decimal point. Type locality Darlot, Western Australia.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Coloration: head dark brown, slightly darker than the pronotum; postclypeus and antennae distinctly paler; anteclypeus transparent; legs, labrum and maxillary palps yellow ochre to ochre yellow-brown; pleura mostly yellow ochre tinged with brown, sternites yellow ochre with brown around the spiracles; mesonotum, metanotum and their tergites slightly paler than the pronotum; wings dark brown, the veins very distinct. Head hemispherical behind the eyes, angularly descending in front of the frontal gland, slightly wider than the pronotum, densely clothed with long and short setae; eyes small and projecting, diameter 0.192; ocelli oval, 0.096×0.144, 0.128 from the eye; antennae 16-segmented; postclypeus densely setose, length 0.48, width 0.65; frontal-gland pore large, about as large as an ocellus. Pronotum large, anterior margin nearly straight, anterolateral corners slightly rounded, the sides sloping down to the slightly wavy posterior margin. Wings large and dark, the first two veins densely setose on the basal half. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 14.25—14.50; without wings 7.50—8.00; head length to the tip of the labrum 1.60—1.67; head length to the frontoclypeal suture 0.74—0.80; head width including eyes 1.30; antennal length 2.04; pronotum length 0.68, width 1.24; forewing length 12.50, width 3.28; hindwing length 12.00, width 3.40; hind tibia length 1.30.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Coloration: head yellow ochre; thorax, mouthparts (except the mandibles) and legs pale buff; mandibles yellow ochre at the base, gradually becoming deep chestnut towards the apex; labrum and clypeus yellow ochre, the anterior margin bordered with a transparent rim; a deep chestnut spot at the mandibular articulation. Head long and hardly widening at the sides, posterior margin wide and nearly flat, strongly arched dorsally; setae sparse, reddish brown, most numerous on the frons; mandibles rather short, slightly longer than half the head capsule, stout, strongly incurved at the apex, each with a tooth placed near the base and far from the apex; labrum medium-sized, conical, slightly more than half the mandible length; clypeus shorter than the labrum, anterior margin deeply bilobed with a broad transparent rim; antennae 15-segmented; postmentum about one-quarter as wide as the head. Pronotum short and wide, sparsely setose; anterolateral corners distinctly projecting forwards. Measurements (mm): body length 5.50—6.00; head length including mandibles 2.35—2.41; head length to the tip of the labrum 2.04; head length to the lateral suture 1.62; head width 1.36—1.42; postmentum length 0.32; pronotum length 0.50, width 0.93; hind tibia length 1.24.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Coloration warm buff, the frons nearly white; antennae slightly darker than the head; mandibles chestnut; head hemispherical behind the antennal insertions, very sparsely setose; postclypeus about four-thirds as wide as long, strongly arched, anterior margin truncate, posterior margin distinctly convex, with a deep rusty spot at each end; antennae 16-segmented. Measurements (mm): body length 4.50—4.90; head length to the frontoclypeal suture 1.05; head width 1.30; pronotum length 0.43, width 0.86.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: Darlot, Western Australia (collected by Charles Biddle, 6 December 1927 (month 12, day 6)). The type specimens (alate, soldier, worker) are deposited with the author.
